steps.title: Bem-vindo: Daily Life - Volume 2
steps.text: In this A1-level lesson, we'll explore essential vocabulary and phrases about "Daily Life". Get ready to level up your real-world communication skills!

words.example: I have a few errands to run this afternoon.
My daily commute takes about an hour.
The traffic was terrible this morning.

steps.text: It means: "Something very easy to do.". Say the example sentence out loud:
